image_description: A close-up view of a grey whale surfacing in blue water. The image focuses on the head and upper back, showing the characteristic mottled grey skin with white barnacle patches (callosities). The arched rostrum is visible breaking the surface, but the blowholes are obscured by the angle and water. No dorsal fin is present, consistent with the species, though the dorsal knuckles are not clearly defined in this specific crop. The pectoral fins and tail flukes are outside the frame.
